build_ViTModel_from_config: build a ViT model from a config dataclass using ViTModel.from_config with pretrained or random initialization
create_ViTAttention_with_masking: create a ViTAttention module that supports attention masks by using BertSelfAttention for vision language input
create_ViTLayer_block: create a ViTLayer block with layernorm before and after self-attention plus intermediate and output sublayers
create_ViTEncoder_with_layers: create a ViTEncoder with a configurable number of ViTLayer modules supporting gradient checkpointing
run_ViTModel_forward: run the ViTModel forward pass with input values, attention mask, and optional head mask to get hidden states
